outcome decision.eligibility.outcome
  1 of 3 subjects may be scored under the task’s evidence policy.
  record=eligibility:e-1 decision_request=dr-1
reason decision.inspection.source_stale
  2 subjects are held because a source observation is older than the evidence policy allows: subject2 and subject3.
  record=eligibility:e-1 subject=subject2 subject=subject3
  identifiers subject2 subject3
reason decision.inspection.subject_unsupported
  1 subject is held because the subject has no supported evidence: subject2.
  record=eligibility:e-1 subject=subject2
  identifiers subject2
next decision.eligibility.next
  Subjects that may not be scored are inspected ordinarily; fix the evidence named above and request a new decision to score them.
  record=eligibility:e-1
